onset.Description: Onset of the event, in seconds from the start of the run.

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds. Zero for point events.

onset_in_video.Description: Onset of the event in its repetition's replay video (gamelogs/*_recording.mp4, named after the repetition's stim_file), in seconds from the video's first frame: frame_start divided by the frame rate. n/a for a repetition without a replay.

trial_type.Description: Event type: a family, optionally followed by qualifiers separated by `/`, e.g. `EnemyDefeated/Stomp/Goomba`. `Levels` lists every value.

Levels.Repetition: One stretch of play recorded in a single replay file; every other event falls inside it.
Levels.Screen/Death: The death animation plays after the player dies.
Levels.Screen/Gameplay: The player controls the character during gameplay.
Levels.Screen/LevelEnd: The level-clear sequence plays after the player finishes the stage.
Levels.Screen/LevelIntro: The world and level number appear before gameplay begins.
Levels.Screen/Transition: The game shows travel between areas or a fade into play.
Levels.Action/Down: The player holds down to crouch or enter a pipe below.
Levels.Action/Jump: The player presses jump to leap or swim upward.
Levels.Action/Left: The player holds left to move or steer left.
Levels.Action/Right: The player holds right to move or steer right.
Levels.Action/Run: The player presses run to move faster or throw fireballs as Fire Mario.
Levels.Action/Start: The player presses start to pause the game.
Levels.Action/Up: The player holds up to climb a vine.
Levels.BlockSmashed: The player smashes a brick block.
Levels.CastleVisible: The castle at the end of the level comes into view.
Levels.CheckpointReached: The player passes the midway point, where play resumes after a death.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/BulletBill: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a Bullet Bill, a flying bullet.

Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/GreenKoopa: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a green Koopa Troopa, a turtle with a green shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/GreenParatroopa: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a hopping green Koopa Paratroopa, a winged turtle.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/HammerBro: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a Hammer Bro, a turtle that throws hammers.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/Lakitu: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a Lakitu, a turtle riding a cloud.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/PiranhaPlant: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a Piranha Plant, a biting plant emerging from a pipe.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/RedKoopa: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a red Koopa Troopa, a turtle with a red shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/RedParatroopa: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a red Koopa Paratroopa, a flying turtle.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Projectile/Spiny: The player defeats an enemy with a projectile or another attack: a Spiny, a turtle with a spiked shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Shell/BuzzyBeetle: The player defeats an enemy with a moving shell: a Buzzy Beetle, a beetle with a hard shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Shell/GreenKoopa: The player defeats an enemy with a moving shell: a green Koopa Troopa, a turtle with a green shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Shell/RedKoopa: The player defeats an enemy with a moving shell: a red Koopa Troopa, a turtle with a red shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Stomp/BuzzyBeetle: The player defeats an enemy by jumping on it: a Buzzy Beetle, a beetle with a hard shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Stomp/Goomba: The player defeats an enemy by jumping on it: a Goomba, a small walking mushroom.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Stomp/GreenKoopa: The player defeats an enemy by jumping on it: a green Koopa Troopa, a turtle with a green shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Stomp/GreenParatroopaFly: The player defeats an enemy by jumping on it: a flying green Koopa Paratroopa, a winged turtle.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Stomp/GreenParatroopaJump: The player defeats an enemy by jumping on it: a hopping green Koopa Paratroopa, a winged turtle.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Stomp/RedKoopa: The player defeats an enemy by jumping on it: a red Koopa Troopa, a turtle with a red shell.
Levels.EnemyDefeated/Stomp/RedParatroopa: The player defeats an enemy by jumping on it: a red Koopa Paratroopa, a flying turtle.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/Blooper: An enemy is visible on screen: a Blooper, a swimming squid.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/BulletBill: An enemy is visible on screen: a Bullet Bill, a flying bullet.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/BuzzyBeetle: An enemy is visible on screen: a Buzzy Beetle, a beetle with a hard shell.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/FlyingCheepCheep: An enemy is visible on screen: a flying Cheep Cheep, a fish leaping through the air.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/Goomba: An enemy is visible on screen: a Goomba, a small walking mushroom.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/GreenKoopa: An enemy is visible on screen: a green Koopa Troopa, a turtle with a green shell.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/GreenParatroopaFly: An enemy is visible on screen: a flying green Koopa Paratroopa, a winged turtle.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/GreenParatroopaJump: An enemy is visible on screen: a hopping green Koopa Paratroopa, a winged turtle.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/GreyCheepCheep: An enemy is visible on screen: a slow-swimming Cheep Cheep.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/HammerBro: An enemy is visible on screen: a Hammer Bro, a turtle that throws hammers.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/Lakitu: An enemy is visible on screen: a Lakitu, a turtle riding a cloud.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/PiranhaPlant: An enemy is visible on screen: a Piranha Plant, a biting plant emerging from a pipe.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/RedCheepCheep: An enemy is visible on screen: a red Cheep Cheep, a swimming fish.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/RedKoopa: An enemy is visible on screen: a red Koopa Troopa, a turtle with a red shell.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/RedParatroopa: An enemy is visible on screen: a red Koopa Paratroopa, a flying turtle.
Levels.EnemyOnScreen/Spiny: An enemy is visible on screen: a Spiny, a turtle with a spiked shell.
Levels.FlagpoleVisible: The flagpole at the end of the level comes into view.
Levels.ItemCollected/Coin: The player picks up a coin.
Levels.ItemCollected/Powerup: The player picks up a mushroom, flower or star power-up.
Levels.ItemOnScreen/Fireworks: An item is visible on screen: fireworks bursting above the castle.
Levels.ItemOnScreen/JumpspringObject: An item is visible on screen: a springboard that boosts jumps.
Levels.ItemOnScreen/Powerup: An item is visible on screen: a mushroom, flower or star power-up.
Levels.ItemOnScreen/VineObject: An item is visible on screen: a vine the player can climb.
Levels.LevelCompleted: The player reaches the goal and completes the level.
Levels.LevelExited/Warp: The player leaves the level through a warp pipe to a later world.
Levels.LevelRestarted: The player restarts the level after dying.
Levels.LevelStarted: A new attempt begins at the start of the level.
Levels.LifeGained: The player earns an extra life.
Levels.PlayerDamaged: The player is hit and gets hurt but survives.
Levels.PlayerDied/Enemy: The player is killed by an enemy or a harmful object.
Levels.PlayerDied/Fall: The player falls into a pit and dies.
Levels.PlayerDied/Timeout: The player dies because the level timer runs out.
Levels.PlayerState/Fire: The player is Fire Mario and can throw fireballs.
Levels.PlayerState/HitRecovery: The player blinks after being hit and is briefly invulnerable.
Levels.PlayerState/Small: The player is small Mario, with no power-up abilities.
Levels.PlayerState/Star: The player is invincible after touching a star.
Levels.PlayerState/Super: The player is Super Mario and survives a hit by shrinking.
Levels.ShellStartedMoving: A kicked shell starts sliding along the ground.
Levels.TimerWarningStarted: The game warns that the level timer is about to run out.

frame_start.Description: Index of the first emulator frame of the event, relative to the start of its repetition.

frame_stop.Description: Index of the last emulator frame of the event, relative to the start of its repetition.

button.Description: Raw controller button underlying an Action/* event; `Levels` gives the event each button produces. n/a for all other events.

stim_file.Description: Path to the .bk2 replay of the repetition. Set on the Repetition row only; every other event falls inside exactly one of those windows. Per-repetition metadata (phase, IndexInRun, IndexGlobal, IndexLevel, Outcome) lives in the matching gamelogs/*_summary.json. 'Missing file' marks a repetition whose .bk2 was lost; its row is kept, with no events inside it.
